class Solution:
    def countSubarrays(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        max_bit = max(x.bit_length() for x in nums)
        n = len(nums)
        nums.append(-1)
        l = [-1] * max_bit
        ans = 0
        for ii in range(n):
            x = nums[ii]
            y = x
            if (x & k) == k:
                indices = set([-1])
                i = 0
                while x:
                    x, bit = divmod(x, 2)
                    if bit and l[i] is not None:
                        indices.add(l[i])
                    i += 1
                x = prev = y
                prev_i = ii
                for index in sorted(indices, reverse=True):
                    x &= nums[index]
                    # print(l)
                    # print(x, prev, index, ii)
                    if prev == k:
                        ans += (prev_i - index)
                    prev = x
                    prev_i = index
            x = y

            for i in range(max_bit):
                x, bit = divmod(x, 2)
                if not bit:
                    l[i] = ii
        return ans

class Solution:
    def countSubarrays(self, v: List[int], k: int) -> int:

        s = set()
        n = len(v)
        ans = 0

        mp = {}

        for i in range(n):
            q = set()

            q.add(v[i])
            if v[i] == k:
                ans += 1
            new_mp = {}
            new_mp[v[i]] = new_mp.get(v[i], 0) + 1

            for z in s:
                new_and = z & v[i]
                q.add(new_and)
                new_mp[new_and] = new_mp.get(new_and, 0) + mp.get(z, 0)
                if new_and == k:
                    ans += mp.get(z, 0)

            mp = new_mp
            s = q

        return ans
